title: AIF Shared Evidence Reference (EvidenceRef v0.1)
description: Canonical EvidenceRef used across all eight assurance components (C-01 .. C-08) and detector adapters. Enforces AIF-007 (5 mandatory fields: subject, scope, method, snapshot, limitations), AIF-014A (snapshot_independent), AIF-016 (bounded claim_scope), and AIF-018 (no SKILL_ASSERTION).

subject.description: What artifact, execution, or subsystem this evidence observes (AIF-007).

scope.description: Explicit paths, components, or surfaces covered by this evidence (AIF-007).

method.description: How this evidence was obtained (AIF-007, AIF-006A).

limitations.description: Explicit limitations or blind spots of the evidence (AIF-007).

claim_scope.description: Bounded statement of what the evidence actually covers (never an unbounded universal claim, AIF-016).

snapshot_independent.description: True only for authority/intake evidence that remains valid across S0->S3 code mutations (AIF-014A).
